{{Quote|Chatter indicated that Nar Shaddaa was the source of weapons, supplies, stimulants used by the Eagle's terrorist network. Retired asset Watcher X was chosen to assist primary (Cipher Nine) due to extensive local knowledge. The terror cell was identified as operating out of VerveGen, a local medical corporation. Leadership was eliminated and data retrieved.|Operational summary of the mission|<ref name="TOR:OGEA">{{TORcite|type=codex|Operation: Glass Echo (Agent)}}</ref>}}
'''Operation: Glass Echo''' was a covert [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operation carried out by the agent codenamed [[Cipher Nine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Hunt for the Eagle]]. The [[Cipher Agent]] located and eliminated a branch of the [[Eagle's network]] that was operating out of the local medical company [[VerveGen Corporation|VerveGen]], receiving assistance from former operative [[Watcher X]].
